patch_description: This variant retains the strongly regularized single shared parameter and the existing local-to-global CZ topology. It inserts a parity-alternating half-mixer immediately after the first brickwork CZ layer, refreshing superposition before the staggered and antipodal interactions. Reusing `shared_mix` adds no distinct trainable parameters, while the interleaving may improve information propagation, gradient flow, worst-group separation, and held-out generalization.
